summary: This study is testing a daily oral drug called aleniglipron to help with long-term weight management in adults who are overweight or have obesity and a weight-related health condition. Participants will take either the drug or an inactive placebo along with a reduced-calorie diet and more physical activity. The study is currently Recruiting and plans to include 3600 participants. NCT07654361 is the study's identification number.
